name: Matanga Hill (Hampi)
description: Climb at sunrise for a sweeping view over the boulder-strewn ruins of Hampi.

name: Belum Caves
description: One of the longest cave systems on the Indian subcontinent with striking stalactite formations.

name: Gandikota
description: The "Grand Canyon of India" with red gorges carved by the Penna river.

name: Lepakshi
description: A Vijayanagara temple town famous for its hanging pillar and giant monolithic Nandi.

name: Araku Valley
description: Coffee plantations and misty hills in the Eastern Ghats with tribal culture.

name: Horsley Hills
description: A quiet hill station with eucalyptus forests and cool viewpoints.

name: Talakona Waterfall
description: The tallest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh set inside the Sri Venkateswara National Park.

name: Yaganti
description: A serene Shiva temple among caves and rocky hills where the Nandi is said to keep growing.

name: Maredumilli
description: Dense forest and bamboo groves with waterfalls and stays near the Godavari region.

name: Kudle Beach (Gokarna)
description: A calm crescent beach with cafes and sunset views away from the usual crowds.

name: Dhanushkodi
description: A ghost town at the tip of Rameswaram where two seas meet.

name: Kolli Hills
description: Hairpin-bend roads and herbal forests and the Agaya Gangai waterfall.

name: Kolukkumalai
description: Sunrise above the clouds at one of the highest tea estates in the world.
